BiblicalUsage: Kelita appears among the Levites who put away foreign wives after the return, then among those who helped the people understand the law when Ezra read it, and then among the men who sealed the covenant. Three mentions, one faithful Levite serving where the law was read and the promises were kept.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Kelita matters because the men who taught the law and sealed the covenant are named one by one — God remembers the faithful by name.
RelatedTopics: Exile and Return; Return from exile
